## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

Its central theme concerns how one may preserve spiritual freedom within a world rife with disputes. In modern studies examining whether the Aṭṭhakavagga suttas advocate release from rebirth, verse 902 of the sutta is highlighted as a rare passage explicitly touching on the theme, asking why one should tremble or desire anything when for them there is no passing away and reappearing (*cutūpapāto*) [Ruegg & Schmithausen 1990].
